concept: Flamengo is styled as a warm, editorial Mexican-American taqueria-gelateria — sophisticated and sensory rather than folkloric. The visual language draws on sun-baked adobe walls, hand-painted nieves carts, and Mexico City's contemporary dining scene: generous whitespace meets rich terracotta, ink-deep headlines in an optical serif sit beside light-touch glassmorphism cards, and a mango-amber accent punctuates the palette like a squeeze of fresh limón. Bento grid layouts give every section editorial structure; Framer Motion scroll reveals and hover micro-interactions add kinetic life without excess. The result is a site that feels genuinely premium, bilingual (EN/ES), and unmistakably alive.

surfaceAlt.use: alternate sections, testimonial bg — deeper parchment

ink.use: primary text and headings — near-black with warm undertone (contrast ~17:1 on bg)

inkSoft.use: secondary / body text — warm mid-dark (contrast ~7.1:1 on bg, passes AA)

primaryDark.use: primary hover state, pressed, high-contrast variant

secondary.use: agave / avocado green — veg badges, secondary actions

accent.use: mango-amber highlight — ice cream section, price tags, star ratings

contrastNotes: ink (#1A1210) on bg (#FAF8F3): ~17.2:1 — passes AAA. ink on surface (#F2EBE0): ~15.4:1 — passes AAA. inkSoft (#5C5248) on bg: ~7.1:1 — passes AA for normal text. inkSoft on surface: ~6.4:1 — passes AA. primary (#C13A0F) on bg: ~4.6:1 — passes AA for normal text and large text. White (#FFFFFF) on primary (#C13A0F): ~4.6:1 — passes AA (use for CTA button labels). White on primaryDark (#8B2200): ~7.8:1 — passes AAA. ink on accent (#F5A623): ~9.1:1 — passes AAA (use dark text on amber badges). secondary (#2E6B4A) on bg: ~5.2:1 — passes AA. All interactive focus rings use primary at 2px offset on bg, meeting WCAG 2.4.11.

display.note: Optical-size variable serif — use 9 optical axis for punchy display, 144 for refined subheadings. Italics used for pull-quotes and menu item descriptions.

body.note: Humanist sans-serif optimised for screen legibility — 400 body, 500 UI labels, 600 nav, 700 price/badge text.

animations.description: Motion is warm and organic — nothing mechanical. Entrances use gentle upward drift (fadeUp) at 0.4 s with a cubic ease-out; staggered children feel like revealing a dish plate-by-plate. Hover interactions are snappy (0.2 s) to feel responsive. Parallax on the hero is subtle (max 40 px displacement) to avoid motion sickness. AnimatePresence wraps all conditional renders (lightbox, lang toggle, mobile menu). Prefer `will-change: transform` only on actively animating elements. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling all transitions via CSS and setting `reducedMotion: 'user'` in Framer Motion's MotionConfig.

framerVariants.fadeUp: initial: { opacity: 0, y: 24 } — animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } — transition: { duration: 0.45, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] } (custom ease-out-expo). Used on every Reveal wrapper.
framerVariants.stagger: Parent container variant with staggerChildren: 0.08 and delayChildren: 0.1. Children inherit fadeUp. Used in bento grids, menu item lists, and highlights section.
framerVariants.scaleIn: initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 } — animate: { opacity: 1, scale: 1 } — transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }. Used for modal/lightbox entrance and badge pop-in.
framerVariants.hoverLift: whileHover: { y: -6, boxShadow: '0 16px 48px -8px rgba(193,58,15,0.20), 0 4px 16px -4px rgba(26,18,16,0.12)' } — transition: { duration: 0.22, ease: 'easeOut' }. Applied to all .card elements via motion.div.
framerVariants.heroParallax: useScroll + useTransform mapping scrollYProgress [0, 0.5] to y [0, -40] on the hero background image layer, and [0, 0.5] to opacity [1, 0.7] on the overlay. Creates a 40 px max upward drift as user scrolls into the highlights section.
framerVariants.navSlide: Navbar glass opacity animates from 0 to 1 and background blur from 0px to 20px as window.scrollY crosses 80 px. Uses useMotionValue + useTransform + MotionValue.set in a useEffect scroll listener.
framerVariants.imageReveal: Clip-path reveal: initial: { clipPath: 'inset(100% 0 0 0)' } — animate: { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0 0 0)' } — transition: { duration: 0.65, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }. Used on gallery and about section images for a wipe-up entrance.
framerVariants.tabSwitch: AnimatePresence with mode='wait'. Exiting tab: { opacity: 0, x: -12, transition: { duration: 0.18 } }. Entering tab: { opacity: 0, x: 12 } to { opacity: 1, x: 0, transition: { duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOut' } }. Used in MenuSection tabs.

sections.layout: Sticky glassmorphic top bar (position: sticky, top: 0, z-index: 50). Left: logotype in Fraunces 600 + wordmark. Center (desktop): anchor links — Menú, Nieves, Nosotros, Visítanos. Right: EN/ES LangToggle pill + 'Ordenar' CTA button in primary. On scroll > 80 px, glass class activates (backdrop-blur-xl, border-b line). Mobile: hamburger triggers full-screen AnimatePresence overlay menu with staggered nav links.

Full-viewport (100dvh) cinematic split. Left 55 %: editorial Fraunces 900 display headline in 2–3 lines, ink color, with an accent-colored inline word (e.g. 'Auténtico'); subhead in Inter 400 inkSoft; two CTA buttons (primary filled + ghost outline). Right 45 %: full-bleed food photography with heroParallax scroll effect and gradient-hero-overlay for depth. Animated scroll-down indicator (bouncing chevron) at viewport bottom-center. Background texture: subtle noise-overlay on hero bg strip.

Asymmetric 12-column bento grid with 4 feature cards on bg #FAF8F3. Card 1 (col-span-7, tall): Signature Tacos hero card with full-bleed image, glass overlay text, hoverLift animation. Card 2 (col-span-5): Nieves & Ice Cream with accent gradient header. Card 3 (col-span-5): Happy Hour / Daily Specials with secondary green accent. Card 4 (col-span-7): rotating Today's Special strip with animated marquee of menu items. Each card uses motion.div with fadeUp + stagger. Collapses to single column on mobile.

Full-width section on surfaceAlt bg with a sticky category tab bar (Tacos · Tortas · Nieves · Bebidas) as pill tabs in primary color. Active tab: filled primary bg + white text. Content area: 2-column grid of menu item rows (name bold Inter 600, description Inter 400 inkSoft, price badge accent). Vegetarian/vegan items marked with badge-veg. Section reveals via Reveal wrapper fadeUp stagger. Tab content switches via AnimatePresence tabSwitch variant. Dietary legend at bottom.

Two-column split (50/50) on surface bg. Left: collage-style 2×2 photo grid with imageReveal animations, slight rotation offset on one image for editorial feel. Right: editorial copy block — overline label in Inter 600 uppercase primary, H2 in Fraunces 900, body paragraphs in Inter 400, drop-cap on opening paragraph using CSS ::first-letter. Below copy: stat trio row (est. year, taco varieties, nieves flavors) in large Fraunces numerals + Inter labels. Collapses to stacked single column on mobile.

Masonry bento grid of 8 food/atmosphere photos in a 3-column CSS grid with varying row spans (tall:2, normal:1). Each image wrapped in motion.div with hoverLift + scale 1.03 on hover. Hover overlay: glass-dark panel slides up revealing item name in Fraunces italic + accent-colored category tag. Click opens Framer Motion AnimatePresence lightbox (full-screen, z-50, imageReveal). Mobile: horizontal scroll-snap strip (snap-x-mandatory) showing 1.15 cards at a time.

Stacked card carousel on surfaceAlt noise-overlay bg. Three visible cards with prev/next arrow controls and dot pagination. Each card: star rating in accent color, pull-quote in Fraunces 400 italic ink ~text-2xl, reviewer name in Inter 600 + platform badge (Google/Yelp). Cards use scaleIn on enter, opacity fade on exit via AnimatePresence. Auto-advances every 5 s, pauses on hover/focus. Accessible: aria-live region announces active testimonial.

Asymmetric split on surface bg. Left (55 %): embedded Google Map iframe with rounded-xl border and a branded custom map style (warm color scheme via Google Maps styled JSON). Right (45 %): vertically stacked — address block with secondary-color icon, hours table (Mon–Sun, two-column, accent highlight for today's row), then a compact reservation/inquiry form. Form fields: bottom-border-only style on bg, Inter 400 labels float on focus, submit button full-width primary. Form uses React Hook Form + Zod for validation.

Dark footer on ink (#1A1210) bg. Three-column grid: (1) Brand logo + bilingual tagline EN/ES, social icon links (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok) in inkSoft-on-dark style; (2) Quick nav links in Inter 500 #FFFFFF/70 with hover underline primary; (3) Newsletter micro-form (email input + arrow button) + address lines. Thin line (rgba white 0.10) hairline divider above bottom bar. Bottom bar: copyright string + accessibility statement link, both in inkSoft equivalent for dark (#8B7F7A).
